name: Three Five (III-V) Materials, Inc.
old_description: our product line which enables us to offer a complete solution to our customer for their
about:
Three Five Compounds, also known as III-V Compounds, operates a sales office in New York, New York, and a production facility in Asia. The company was established as a supplier of opto-electronic semiconductor materials, though the exact founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures a broad range of opto-electronic products, from epitaxial wafers and raw dice through packaged devices and finished modules. Its material portfolio includes GaP, GaAsP, AlGaAs, AlInGaP, and GaN for emitters covering 350–1100 nm, plus silicon PIN photodiode and phototransistor chips. Finished goods span LED display modules (full-color, 7-segment), LCD modules, OLEDs, discrete through-hole LEDs (3 mm and 5 mm) and surface-mount packages (1206, 0805, 0603, 0402) in single, bi-color, and tri-color configurations. Specialty packages such as flat-top and TO-header devices serve fiber-optic and sensor applications. III-V also supplies plastic, ESKA, and silica optical fiber, and provides printed circuit board assembly (PCBA/PWBA) and flexible printed circuit (FPC) assembly, including Kapton-based circuits. The Asian production floor employs over 400 workers.

Customers come from general lighting, display, automotive, sensor, medical, telecommunication, military, and commercial sectors. Medical and military companies worldwide, as well as traffic and automotive clients, use the company’s components. Examples include medical sensor and board assemblies, silica fiber for telecommunication and medical usage, and medical cable and wire harnesses.

The company emphasizes a "one-stop-shop" model, assisting customers from initial concept through production completion. It highlights flexibility, high-quality standards, just-in-time delivery, and special product selection to meet strict application requirements as key differentiators.

name: Thuren Fabrication
old_description: It is recommended to send an email whenever possible, as it provides a written record for future reference.
about:
Thuren Fabrication operates from Bend, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, though Don Thuren is identified as the owner contact for warranty and shock tuning matters.

The company designs and manufactures high-performance suspension components for Dodge Ram trucks, including track bars, steering components, suspension joints, sway bars, leaf springs, and universal fabrication parts. Product lines cover Ram 3500, 2500, 1500, Power Wagon, and TRX/RHO models across multiple generations. The firm also provides technical resources such as suspension design guides, build planning, tire and wheel fitment data, alignment specifications, and detailed explanations of phenomena like death wobble. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Thuren Fabrication serves the automotive aftermarket, primarily targeting Dodge Ram owners and off-road enthusiasts. It also supports a network of installing dealers who fit the company's parts. Direct customer support is handled by named staff: Andrew Patrick for installation and alignment questions, Casey Bergum for second-generation and welding inquiries, and Don Thuren for warranty, shock builds, and website issues.

The company emphasizes extensive technical documentation and direct access to its principals as a point of differentiation, though it does not formally articulate a founding mission or unique selling proposition beyond its product focus.

name: TianBa Process Equipment USA, LLC
old_description: Founded in 1999, TianBa Process Systems is a food process equipment company that is focused on the manufacture and delivery of thermal treatment processing solutions worldwide.
about:
TianBa Process Equipment USA, LLC is based in Sarasota, Florida. The company was founded in 1999 as a food process equipment specialist focused on thermal treatment processing solutions for global markets.

The company designs, develops, manufactures, and commercializes fully automated HTST pasteurization and UHT aseptic sterilization systems. It also provides upstream blending and processing systems, downstream aseptic tank systems, and turnkey blending, clean-in-place (CIP), and thermal processing solutions. TianBa has installed more than 250 dairy, beverage, and food process systems worldwide, and offers the ProcessEasy™ automation platform for centralized equipment control.

TianBa serves the dairy, beverage, and food processing industries, with systems operating across North and South America, North and South Asia, Central America, and Africa. Its equipment produces aseptic milk, juice, sauces, coffee, tea, fruit juices, and ready-to-drink products in both refrigerated and shelf-stable packages.

The company emphasizes innovation, quality, safety, and environmental responsibility. Its mission includes delivering customized solutions, implementing industry trends in equipment designs, manufacturing reliable components, providing outstanding customer service, and offering fair prices. A strong R&D team focuses on pasteurization, sterilization, and particulate processing, maintaining close customer collaboration throughout design and commissioning.

name: Tipton Mills Foods LLC
old_description: Your Partner in Innovative Food and Powdered Drink Manufacturing
about:
Tipton Mills Foods LLC operates from Columbus, Indiana, where it produces custom-blended food and beverage powders for brand owners. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it presents itself as a partner for formulation, supply chain management, manufacturing, packaging, and distribution of powdered products.

The facility runs 11 packaging lines capable of filling pouches, sticks, cans, and jars. Its proprietary Sure-Blend agglomeration process is designed to improve powder dispensability by up to 95 percent. The company handles nutritional, convenience, and indulgence product categories, offering turnkey services from recipe development through to finished goods, including private labeling and quality control.

Tipton Mills serves powdered-beverage brand owners, consumer beverage companies, and growing brands that need to scale quickly. Its Express Launch Process has helped more than a dozen clients increase production within 60 days, enabling placement in national retail chains. The company also works with brands facing out-of-stock issues and solubility challenges.

The company emphasizes creativity, integrity, and innovation as guiding principles. It highlights its ability to deliver certified organic and kosher products, responsive customer service, and a team-focused culture aimed at making projects easy to execute.

about:
Titone Custom Metal Works, doing business as TCMW Inc., is a custom metal fabrication and welding shop located in Tiverton, Rhode Island. The company does not publish a founding date or ownership structure, and no founders are named in its public materials.

The shop specializes in stainless steel and aluminum fabrication, powder coating, and welding for marine applications. Its capabilities include marine tops, custom railings, and architectural railings, all built to order. The company emphasizes that it does not supply pre-made or bolt-together systems; each project is measured and fabricated to the exact specifications of the customer's vessel.

The primary market is the marine industry, serving boat owners and builders who need custom-fitted tops and railings. Architectural railing work represents a secondary line of business. No other industry verticals or specific customer names are disclosed.

TCMW states that quality and customer satisfaction are its highest priorities, and that a job is not finished until the client is completely satisfied. The shop differentiates itself by designing each project from the ground up, guiding customers through every step, and rejecting quick-turn, standardized approaches in favor of detailed, custom engineering.

name: Tokyo Electron America
old_description: Tokyo Electron Donates to Support 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake Relief Efforts
about:
Tokyo Electron America operates from Manassas, Virginia, as the U.S. arm of Tokyo Electron Ltd., a Japanese public company that has cultivated semiconductor process technology for over six decades. The American subsidiary focuses on developing, manufacturing, and selling semiconductor production equipment while providing related technical support and parts services.

The company’s product portfolio spans the front-end fabrication line: the Ulucus™ G wafer thinning system and Ulucus™ LX extreme laser lift-off tool for 300 mm wafers; Episode™ 1 and Episode™ 2 DMR single-wafer deposition systems; CLEAN TRACK™ LITHIUS Pro DICE™ coater/developer; EVAROS™ batch thermal processing system; LEXIA™-EX sputtering system; Acrevia™ gas cluster beam system for EUV patterning; and the Prexa™ SDP device prober. A dedicated entity, TEL Manufacturing and Engineering of America, handles domestic production and achieved RBA VAP Platinum status in 2026.

Customers are semiconductor device makers and foundries running 300 mm volume lines. The equipment supports logic, memory, and advanced packaging processes, and the firm collaborates with partners such as NVIDIA on AI-driven factory automation and robotics.

Tokyo Electron states its mission is to contribute to a "dream-inspiring society" by advancing the semiconductor technology that underpins modern electronics, leveraging more than 60 years of process know-how to improve equipment productivity and field operation efficiency through digital transformation concepts like Epsira™.

name: Tom James Company
old_description: Where's the best place to buy a custom suit in Oklahoma City?
about:
Tom James Company operates a custom clothier location at 205 NW 63rd Street, Suite 375 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company, which traces its roots to founder Spencer Hays (1936–2017), does not disclose a founding year in public materials. Ownership structure is not specified in available sources. The Oklahoma City office is staffed by a team of professional clothiers including Carter Ashby, Renee Bickel, Nia Coulter, Maggie Davis, Doug Echard, Steve Gray, and Audrey Wilson.

The company provides bespoke tailoring and custom clothing for men and women, including suits, sport coats, dress shirts, casual shirts, tuxedos, outerwear, and accessories. Rather than maintaining a production facility, Tom James partners with established manufacturers such as Oxxford Clothes to supply fabrics and garment construction. Clothiers conduct wardrobe consultations at clients' homes or offices, taking measurements and guiding fabric and style selections. The Oklahoma City team serves clients across the metropolitan area with no minimum order quantity published.

Tom James targets busy professionals, corporate executives, and individuals seeking formalwear for weddings and special events. Its clientele spans industries such as finance, law, and executive management, with testimonials citing long-term relationships across multiple cities. The company also offers ready-to-wear collections and gift cards through its retail channels.

The company differentiates itself through a mobile service model that brings expert clothiers directly to the client, eliminating the need for store visits. It emphasizes access to a curated selection of premium fabrics and a personalized consulting approach that prioritizes convenience and time savings for high-net-worth individuals.

name: Tom's Foreign Auto Parts
old_description: We inspect and validate every part, and then we guarantee it.
about:
Tom's Foreign Auto Parts operates from Waterbury, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1985 as a privately owned auto recycling and used parts business. The company began as a dismantling operation focused on foreign vehicles and has grown into one of the internet's sellers of used OEM parts.

The company runs a state-of-the-art auto recycling facility where every vehicle is dismantled and each component is either recycled or reused in an eco-friendly manner. Each part undergoes inspection and validation, is photographed at least three times, and stored indoors until shipment. The online inventory lists over 40,000 new and used auto parts, with in-stock items typically shipping the same day. Every sale includes a standard six-month money-back guarantee, and optional lifetime guarantees are available on select parts.

Tom's serves both online and local customers seeking genuine OEM replacement parts for foreign makes. The buyer base includes professional repair shops and individual vehicle owners who want to avoid dealership pricing. The company emphasizes a no-hassle purchasing experience that eliminates the need to visit salvage yards.

The business was built on the goal of building confidence with every used-part purchase. By combining rigorous quality checks, transparent photography, and a responsive customer-service team, Tom's aims to deliver a reliable alternative to new dealership parts while keeping vehicles on the road affordably.

name: Tone's Spices
old_description: ®, we maximize the flavor of our spices to ensure you get the most out of dinner time with the ones you love.
about:
Tone's Spices operates from Ankeny, Iowa, where the company was founded in 1873 by brothers Jehiel and Isaac Tone. What began as a spice and coffee venture grew into what the brand describes as the oldest spice company in the United States, remaining under the stewardship of the Tone family for generations.

The company manufactures a wide range of spices and seasoning blends — including garlic pepper, Cajun, Italian, lemon pepper, and taco blends — at a facility it characterizes as one of the largest spice production plants in the world. In 1888, the Tone brothers introduced individual pre-ground spice packaging, a shift that moved the industry away from bulk barrels and toward the consumer-ready format common today.

Tone's products are sold directly to home cooks and families through retail channels, with the company emphasizing recipes and meal solutions for everyday dining. Its marketing centers on "dinner time with the ones you love," positioning the brand as a staple for household kitchens rather than industrial or foodservice buyers.

The Tone family's original values — preserving essential oils, ensuring purity, and maximizing flavor — are cited as the continuing foundation for the business. The company frames its scale and heritage as a means to deliver freshness and consistency that "the whole family will love."

name: Tony's Mopar Parts (parts for 60s + 70s Plymouth + Dodge Muscle Cars)
old_description: Tony D. is the most knowledgeable Mopar guy I have ever met. He is my go-to guy and contributes greatly to the accuracy of Graveyard Carz." - Mark Worman
about:
Tony's Parts operates from Harrington, Delaware, where it was founded in 1977 by Tony D'Agostino. The business began as a part-time venture when D'Agostino sold surplus parts from a 1970 GTX to fund his own Road Runner restoration, eventually growing into a full-time operation with two large warehouses and a stock of donor vehicles.

The company specializes in new old stock (NOS) and used parts for Plymouth and Dodge muscle cars built between 1962 and 1974. It maintains an extensive inventory across its two warehouses and provides technical assistance and parts identification services. While Tony's Parts once manufactured select reproduction components, those items are now distributed through Vans Auto.

Customers range from hobbyist enthusiasts to professional restorers. The company's parts have been featured on the television series Graveyard Carz, and D'Agostino has contributed technical articles to publications such as Mopar Muscle, High-Performance Mopar, and Mopar Action.

Tony's Parts distinguishes itself with a no-hassle return policy, a 100% refund guarantee on all sales, and a practice of referring customers to alternative suppliers when a needed part is not in stock. The founder's decades-long immersion in the Mopar community and his published expertise underpin the business's reputation.
